subject: Offer package review: SDE2 (Jordan Price) - base/bonus/equity
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: TalentRun Recruiting <recruiting@talentrun.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer package proposal: SDE2 - Jordan Price

Team —

Attached is the proposed offer for Jordan Price (SDE2). High-level:
- Base: $165,000
- Target bonus: 10% (annual)
- Equity: 0.25% RSU with 4-year vest (1y cliff)

Rationale: Jordan has strong backend experience, led a microservices migration at his last role, and will be a close match for the infra team. Candidate prefers earlier equity strike if possible; they indicated multiple competing offers so we want to be competitive but within band.

Open items I want leadership/comp committee input on before we send:
1) Equity size — above band midpoint for SDE2; can we flex to 0.3% or keep at 0.25%?
2) Signing bonus — candidate asked if we can add a $10k sign-on to offset forfeited bonus at current employer.
3) Headcount confirmation — is the req cleared for hiring this quarter? CC'ing Markus for final headcount/finance signoff.

Attached: offer_SDE2_JPrice_v2.pdf, comp_matrix_SDE2.csv, headcount_request_7-11.pdf

Next steps: Laura/Markus — please reply with approvals or suggested edits. If we can greenlight today I’ll route to TalentRun to send to candidate.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer package proposal: SDE2 - Jordan Price

Jonas — thanks for the write-up and attachments. Quick thoughts after reviewing the comp matrix: 

- Base: $165k is within band; I suggest we move to $168k to be more competitive (candidate has two external offers, one at $170k).
- Bonus: 10% target is fine. No need to change.
- Equity: 0.25% RSU is below what I would give for someone with Jordan's systems experience. Recommend 0.35% capped but we should confirm with finance. If we do 0.35% we should reduce sign-on to $5k.
- Signing bonus: I agree on a $5k sign-on instead of $10k. Helps economics and signals flexibility.
- Vesting/refresh: Standard 4y/1y cliff; add a note about an eligibility check for first refresh at 12 months based on performance.

Marcus — can you confirm whether 0.35% is materially different for comp reporting and whether we have runway in the equity pool? Also need headcount approval confirmation from Markus.

If both finance and headcount are OK, I approve moving forward with the revised package (base $168k / 10% bonus / 0.35% RSU / $5k sign-on).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer package proposal: SDE2 - Jordan Price

All —

Headcount: approved (we have the FTE slot in Q3 hiring plan). Marcus — finance check on equity: if we move to 0.35% RSU that pushes the comp-reporting midpoint up for the band but it's still within our uplift threshold. Marcus, can you confirm impact on 2028 pool usage and reporting?

I also pushed a minor redline to the offer (attached) that clarifies start date window and forfeiture language for equity in the event of delayed start. No other changes from Laura's suggestion.

If Marcus signs off on equity, I approve the revised package: $168k base / 10% bonus / 0.35% RSU / $5k sign-on. Please prepare final offer to send via TalentRun (DocuSign link preferred).

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: headcount_request_7-11.pdf

Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer package proposal: SDE2 - Jordan Price

Markus/Laura/Jonas —

Finance confirms: moving equity to 0.35% is acceptable from a pool usage and comp-reporting perspective. Impact to 2028 equity run-rate is minor given current vesting schedules and projected hires; I attached a quick calc in comp_matrix_SDE2.csv for reference.

I also ran the economics with a $5k sign-on and the numbers look fine. Headcount is cleared per Markus' note.

Approve final package and route to TalentRun to issue via DocuSign. Please include:
- Offer PDF: offer_SDE2_JPrice_v2.pdf (update base to $168k and equity to 0.35%)
- DocuSign link once uploaded

I'll note in the comp report that this was a one-time flex given market competitiveness.

Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Manager, Compensation & Analytics
Redwood Inference
